description: PowerModelsACDC.jl, published by Electa-Git, adds DC lines, meshed DC grids and AC-DC converters to Julia and JuMP power-flow, optimisation and transmission-expansion formulations. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Catalogue records for comparison are model-powermodels-jl. Compatibility with these records has not been assumed.
